subject: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Hi Alyssa,

We’re evaluating lifecycle email tooling for a 4-week growth experiments sprint (self-serve onboarding + early retention) for our Hosted API.

We’re looking for:
- Triggered sequences based on product events (signup, created API key, first request, “first 100k tokens”)
- Segmentation + suppression logic (e.g., don’t email if already activated; suppression for enterprise opps/domains)
- Ability to run A/B tests with holdouts and export experiment results
- Solid deliverability tooling (warming/throttling, domain reputation monitoring, bounce/complaint dashboards)
- GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance: unsubscribe + preferences, deletion workflows, data retention controls
- Integrations: webhook/API in, and ideally outbound to our warehouse (Snowflake) and/or Segment/RudderStack

A few questions to sanity check fit:
1) Events/triggering: do you support server-side events via API (not just web tracking)? Any recommended dedupe/idempotency patterns?
2) Preferences: can we link to a hosted preferences page and also embed an “unsubscribe/manage preferences” surface in our console via API?
3) Data controls: configurable retention for event data and audience lists? How do deletions propagate?
4) Compliance: do you support regional data residency (EU vs US) and DPAs out of the box?
5) Experimentation: A/B at the email level, and/or sequence level? Holdout group capability?
6) Pricing: ballpark cost for 50k–200k sends/month + event ingestion for ~100k new signups/month, with room to scale. Any minimums?

If you can send a pricing sheet + security overview, that’d be helpful. Happy to jump on a call this week if that’s easier.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben Carter
Growth / Lifecycle Experiments
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SendCraft Sales <sales@sendcraft.io>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 12:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the detailed questions — you’re describing a pretty typical “product-led onboarding + activation” workflow, and we can support the requirements you listed.

Quick answers:
1) Events/triggering: Yes, we support server-side events via REST API (JSON payload). We strongly recommend:
   - providing a stable user_id and/or email
   - an event_id for idempotency (we dedupe within a configurable window)
   - event_timestamp for late-arriving events
2) Preferences: We provide a hosted preferences page (branded domain optional). For embedding in your console, you can call our Preferences API to fetch/update opt-in status and categories. Unsubscribe link is required in each email.
3) Data controls: Event retention is configurable (30/90/180/365 days). Audience exports can be scoped and time-limited. Deletion requests can be sent via API and are processed within 7 days.
4) Compliance: Standard DPA available. GDPR features include data subject deletion, audit trail, and configurable retention. EU data residency available on our Enterprise plan.
5) Experimentation: A/B testing at the email template level and sequence branch level. Holdout groups supported via randomization at entry or by bringing your own cohort assignment.
6) Pricing: Attaching a pricing overview (not a quote) — happy to tailor once we understand your send volume and plan features (EU residency, SSO, etc.).

Attachments:
- SendCraft_Pricing_Sheet_2026Q1.pdf
- SendCraft_Security_Overview.pdf
- SendCraft_DPA_Template.pdf

If useful, here’s my calendar for a 30-min overview + Q&A:
https://calendly.com/sendcraft/ben-carter-30min

Best,
Alyssa

Alyssa Chen
Solutions Consultant
SendCraft
alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io

From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 2:04 PM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Alyssa — thanks.

A couple attribution/ops questions on my side:

- Do you support UTM parameter templating and auto-tagging (source/medium/campaign/content) for links in emails?
- Do you have native webhooks for “delivered/open/click/bounce/complaint/unsubscribe” events back to us?
- Can we throttle/ramp by cohort (e.g., 5% of new signups for 2 days, then 25%, etc.) to protect reputation?
- Any built-in guardrails to automatically pause sends if complaint rate/bounce rate crosses a threshold?

We’re trying to keep instrumentation consistent across email + in-console nudges and don’t want to build a bunch of glue if the platform already supports it.

Thanks,
Tyler

Tyler Benson
Marketing Ops & Attribution
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 3:19 PM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Hi Tyler,

Great questions — quick rundown:

- UTM templating: Yes. You can set defaults at the campaign/sequence level and override per-link (supports macros like {{user_id}} / {{campaign_name}}).
- Webhooks: Yes, we can POST engagement + deliverability events to your endpoint in near real-time. We also have a Snowflake export option (hourly) on Growth+.
- Throttling/ramp: Yes. We support ramp by audience/cohort and global limits per hour/day.
- Guardrails: We can alert and/or auto-pause sends when bounce/complaint thresholds are exceeded (configurable), and we surface domain reputation metrics and ISP feedback loops where available.

If you want, I can show these in the UI on a call; otherwise I can send screenshots.

Best,
Alyssa

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 10:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Alyssa,

Looping in privacy/compliance for a few items we’ll need answers on before we proceed.

1) Subprocessors: Please share the current subprocessor list and your notification policy for changes.
2) Data retention: Can we set different retention policies for (a) raw event data, (b) contact records, and (c) message logs? We typically want the shortest retention we can.
3) Data subject requests: Please confirm deletion (and export, if applicable) SLA and what’s left behind in logs after deletion.
4) Tracking: We may disable open tracking for certain cohorts/regions. Is open tracking optional by campaign or globally?
5) Unsubscribe: Confirm global unsubscribe is honored across all workspaces/senders we configure.
6) Security posture: Do you have SOC 2 Type II and can you provide a report under NDA?

Thanks,
Michael

Michael Grant
Privacy Counsel (CAN-SPAM / Privacy)
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@sendcraft.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 1:52 PM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Hi Michael (and Olga),

Happy to cover these:

1) Subprocessors: We maintain an up-to-date list here: https://sendcraft.io/security (Subprocessors section). We notify customers via email 30 days prior to adding a new subprocessor.
2) Data retention: Yes, retention can be configured separately for:
   - Event data (default 180d)
   - Contact records (until deleted; can be automatically removed after X days of inactivity)
   - Message logs (configurable; minimum 30d for deliverability and abuse prevention)
3) DSRs: Deletion requests via API or support ticket. We process within 7 days; immediate suppression is available at request time. After deletion, we retain non-identifying aggregate metrics and certain operational logs required for abuse prevention (no email address/user identifiers).
4) Tracking: Open tracking can be toggled per campaign/sequence. Click tracking is recommended but can be limited; we can discuss the tradeoffs.
5) Unsubscribe: Global unsubscribe is honored across all sends from a workspace/sender identity. We also support category-level preferences.
6) SOC 2: Yes, SOC 2 Type II. We can share the report via our trust portal under NDA. If you send your preferred NDA language, we can route it quickly.

Let me know if you’d like me to join the call with Ben/Tyler to walk through.

Best,
Alyssa

Date: Fri, Jan 16, 2026 at 4:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Vendor eval: lifecycle email tooling for Hosted API onboarding (questions + pricing)

Alyssa — this is helpful.

Two follow-ups before we book time:

1) Pricing clarification: In the pricing sheet, the “Growth+” tier includes Snowflake export and webhooks, but EU residency is Enterprise. Can you confirm whether EU residency is required only for storage/processing in-region, and whether we can still email EU users from US-region infrastructure if we disable certain tracking and keep event storage on our side?

2) Implementation: Our engineering capacity is limited in the sprint. What’s the fastest path to:
   - ingest server-side events
   - create 2–3 onboarding sequences with A/B variants
   - enforce suppression rules (unsubscribe + active enterprise opp list)
   - and send engagement events back to our warehouse

If you can propose a “week 1 launch” checklist + what you need from us (domains, DNS records, etc.), we can assess timeline.

Camila: FYI — we’ll do a quick vendor screen next week and decide whether to run emails via existing tooling vs switch.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben Carter
Growth / Lifecycle Experiments
Redwood Inference
